data.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 2 (BASIC). ROOT_CAUSE: gh pr view --json mergeCommit --jq .mergeCommit.oid returns the source-branch HEAD SHA for squash merges (known GitHub API limitation), not the new squash commit on main. After git fetch, git rev-parse origin/main gives the correct SHA. Fix: fall back to git rev-parse origin/main when API SHA not found on origin/main. confidence: high
